description: "The Castle of Andalusia: A Comic Opera, in Three Acts" by John O'Keeffe is a comedic theatrical work written in the early 19th century. The opera features a range of colorful characters, including Don Cæsar, Spado, and Don Alphonso, as they navigate a plot filled with love, mistaken identities, and banditry centered around a castle in Spain.
